SciArt September, Day 27: Bounded (people.) The state of Michigan, with its two peninsulas, is bounded by four of the five Great Lakes. It has the longest freshwater coastline in the U.S. at 3,288 miles. 🐡🎨 #sciartseptember2025 #bounded #michigan #freshwatercoastline #sciart

Did you know that Michigan has the nation's longest freshwater coastline (3,288 linear miles). Michigan's coast accounts for approximately 62% of the total coastline of the Great Lakes basin (8 US states and 2 Canadian provinces). #PureMichigan

Lake Michigan is 307 miles (494 km) long and 118 miles (190 km) across at its widest point. In comparison, at its widest the United Kingdom is 300 miles (500 km) across. From the northern tip of Scotland to the southern coast of England, it is about 600 miles (1,000 km).

Michigan becomes home to largest freshwater coastline in United States (1925). Michigan's borders give it 3,288 miles of Great Lakes coastline — the longest freshwater coastline of any political subdivision in the world and the longest coastline of any US state east of Alaska.
Michigan alone has 3300 miles of shoreline on 4 of the 5 Great Lakes.
